import bpy, subprocess, os, json
from mathutils import Vector
expected=r'C:\mcp-blender\salvador_lacerda_do_zero.blend'
repo=r'C:\mcp-blender\vendor\projeto-salvador-elevador-lacerda'
venv_py=r'C:\mcp-blender\.venv-geo\Scripts\python.exe'
tmp=r'C:\mcp-blender\.geo-work'
os.makedirs(tmp,exist_ok=True)
if os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(bpy.data.filepath))!=os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(expected)): raise RuntimeError('arquivo Blender errado')
subprocess.run(['git','-C',repo,'fetch','origin','chatgpt/blender-collab'],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
def export_git(path,out,binary=False):
    cp=subprocess.run(['git','-C',repo,'show','FETCH_HEAD:'+path],check=True,capture_output=True,text=not binary,encoding=None if binary else 'utf-8')
    if binary: open(out,'wb').write(cp.stdout)
    else: open(out,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(cp.stdout)
tool=os.path.join(tmp,'derive_world_georef.py'); osm=os.path.join(tmp,'salvador_osm_map.xml'); anchors_path=os.path.join(tmp,'anchors.json'); out=os.path.join(tmp,'world_georef.json')
export_git('tools/derive_world_georef.py',tool)
export_git('data/osm/salvador_osm_map.xml',osm)
c=bpy.data.collections.get('02 ENTORNO | OSM e patamares')
if not c: raise RuntimeError('colecao OSM principal ausente')
anchors=[]
for o in c.objects:
    if o.type not in {'MESH','CURVE'} or 'osm_id' not in o: continue
    try:
        pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(v) for v in o.bound_box]
        x=(min(p.x for p in pts)+max(p.x for p in pts))/2; y=(min(p.y for p in pts)+max(p.y for p in pts))/2
        anchors.append({'osm_id':str(o['osm_id']),'name':o.name,'blender_x':round(x,8),'blender_y':round(y,8)})
    except Exception: pass
open(anchors_path,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(json.dumps(anchors,ensure_ascii=False))
cp=subprocess.run([venv_py,tool,anchors_path,osm,out],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',timeout=180)
print('ANCHORS_EXPORTED='+str(len(anchors)))
print('SOLVER_RC='+str(cp.returncode))
print(cp.stdout)
if cp.stderr.strip(): print('STDERR='+cp.stderr[-3000:])
if cp.returncode: raise RuntimeError('georef solver failed')
result=json.load(open(out,encoding='utf-8'))
print('WORLD_GEOREF_JSON='+json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
print('GEOREF_DERIVE_OK')
